profile_text.body:
# Salesforce

Salesforce is a public company founded in 1999 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. With revenue of $41.525 billion as of January 31, 2026, the company describes itself as providing AI-powered productivity tools integrated into its business software suite. According to its website, the company's approach to AI emphasizes embedding generative capabilities directly into the tools where teams already work, rather than confining them to separate applications.

The company offers three main AI products tracked by this site: Slack AI, embedded in its messaging platform to summarize conversations, search files, take meeting notes, translate messages, and automate workflows; Tableau AI (Einstein), a business intelligence tool featuring natural language queries with CRM data integration and governance through its Trust Layer; and Salesforce Einstein/Agentforce, a CRM-embedded AI system that builds agents capable of querying data and triggering actions within Slack channels and threads. Salesforce emphasizes that customer data is not used to train large language models and that LLM providers do not have access to customer data, with language models hosted directly within Slack's AWS virtual private cloud.

The company is traded as CRM on public markets and is subject to 220 lawsuits in California jurisdiction. Six Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers have been registered that enable integration with Salesforce systems, allowing AI clients to run SOQL queries, manage administration, and orchestrate deployment pipelines.
